# Deno 2.9.8 Rust crate notices

Normal-dependency closure of the `deno` package (`cli/Cargo.toml`) at tag `v2.9.8` (commit `fe7ed012d92c642fd8e5607ac5a45d517538b5c5`). Generated by `tools/generate_deno_crate_notices.py` from `cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --filter-platform <triple>` with Rust 1.95.0, the toolchain pinned in that tag's `rust-toolchain.toml`.

Platforms unioned here:

- `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`
- `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`
- `x86_64-apple-darwin`
- `aarch64-apple-darwin`
- `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`

A crate is listed when a normal dependency edge reaches it on at least one of those platforms. Dev-dependencies and build-dependencies are not followed. Proc-macro crates stay in the list when they are normal dependencies: they run while Deno is compiled and are not linked into the executable. The `Targets` column is `all five` when every platform above reaches that crate version.

The license expression is the `license` field from the crate's `Cargo.toml`. Copyright lines are the `Copyright` lines in the crate's root `LICENSE` / `COPYING` / `NOTICE` files, with a leading comment marker removed. A line that is only the Apache appendix template (`Copyright [yyyy] [name of copyright owner]`) is not treated as a copyright. Crates with no such line say so. Nested trees inside a crate are not walked; the root license file is what this list copies. Two exceptions are written up in [`deno-2.9.8-runtime-notices.md`](deno-2.9.8-runtime-notices.md): crate `v8` 150.4.0 publishes no `LICENSE*` file, and `libz-sys` 1.1.20 vendors zlib-ng under `src/zlib-ng` with its own `LICENSE.md`.

914 crate versions. 99 had no readable root license file.
